description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use when the person asks for this in a system whose AI agent may change records: A task or follow up that already exists moved to another date, retitled, reassigned or marked done, by the id list_related_records or search_tasks gives it; only what is given changes. Give one item per record, at most 25. Nothing is written yet: the answer shows, per record, what it holds now and would hold after, plus a proposal id. Show it to the person, say so first when something would be sent to the people in their system, ask whether to go ahead, and only then call apply_proposal; when needsApproval is true, share the approve link instead. Not for reading (use search_records or get_record).

items.description: One object per record, at most 25.

done.description: True when the task is done, false to open it again.

due_at.description: When it is due now, ISO 8601 in UTC.

id.description: The id of that record in the system, where the system asks for it.

notes.description: The new text on the task.

subject.description: The new title of the task.

task_id.description: The id of the task, as list_related_records or search_tasks gives it.

type.description: The type of the record the task is on, where the system asks for it.

user.description: The id of the user the task is for now, as describe_record_type gives it with include users.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agent_options, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.

name: propose_update_task
title: Propose: Change a task
